title: Roomie
description: A mobile app designed to help users find roommates and housing accommodations. It also provides a platform for users to connect with potential landlords and real estate agents.

title: CleanCycle
description: CleanCycle is a mobile application designed to address the pressing issue of environmental pollution and promote recycling to protect the environment. It serves as a platform for individuals and companies to actively participate in waste management efforts and contribute to a cleaner and more sustainable planet. It also offers a learning center to enlighten the public on environmental facts and correct misconceptions.

title: Search Me Up
description: A full-stack web-based networking and job application platform for users to showcase their skills and experience. It also provides a platform for users to connect with potential employers and recruiters.

title: SYSCX
description: SYSCX is a prototype version of Twitter(X) built for students to allow them to connect and share posts.

title: Finvest
description: Finvest is an Access Control Mechanism research designed to test cryptography and access control matrices in financial institutions by allowing the right permissions, finding loopholes, and ensuring strong and secure user passwords.

title: Mini-Survey Monkey
description: A survey application that allows users to create and respond to surveys, and surveyors to analyze and visualize survey data with features like graphs and charts.

title: Look Inna Book
description: A graphics-based online bookstore programmed using the Java programming language and PostgreSQL as the backend database.
